description:
Get a copy of What If? 2 and Randall’s other books at: https://xkcd.com/books
More serious answers to absurd questions at: https://what-if.xkcd.com/

This question comes from Ji, who asks: “I heard bananas are radioactive. If they’re radioactive, then they radiate energy. How many bananas would you need to power a house?”

Yes, bananas emit radiation, but not very much of it. They’re very safe – until you use them to power a house.
